name: After § 60
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: 60a. calls on the Commission to substantially increase the financial and human resources allocated to the Erasmus+ programme; calls for an increase in the number of grants and for social benefits to be adjusted in line with inflation and changes in the cost of living, in order to ensure that the programme remains affordable, accessible and open to as many people as possible, and that financial constraints do not act as a barrier to student mobility;
